attempt_history.llm_sketch:
workflow_id: pdf_text_extraction_and_structure_detection
steps:
  - id: step_authenticate_user
    op: authenticate_user
    params:
      role: "pdf_reader_user"
    output: auth_result

  - id: step_receive_pdf
    op: fetch_api
    params:
      endpoint: "/client/pdf/selected_file"
      description: "Receive the PDF file selected by the user in the browser"
    output: raw_pdf_data

  - id: step_validate_pdf
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_pdf_data
      schema: pdf_file_schema
      constraints:
        - "must_have_text_layer"
        - "valid_pdf_binary"
    output: validated_pdf

  - id: step_iterate_pages
    op: loop_records
    params:
      input: validated_pdf
      iterator: "page"
      description: "Load the PDF and iterate over each page"
    output: pdf_pages

  - id: step_extract_text_items
    op: extract_field
    params:
      input: pdf_pages
      field: "text_items_with_font_size"
      description: "Extract all text items with their font size metadata from each page"
    output: raw_text_items

  - id: step_validate_text_items
    op: validate_schema
    params:
      input: raw_text_items
      schema: text_item_schema
      required_fields:
        - "content"
        - "font_size"
        - "page_number"
    output: validated_text_items

  - id: step_compute_median_font_size
    op: aggregate_data
    params:
      input: validated_text_items
      group_by: "all"
      aggregation: "median"
      field: "font_size"
      description: "Compute the median font size to establish the body text baseline"
    output: median_font_stats

  - id: step_merge_text_with_median
    op: merge_datasets
    params:
      input: validated_text_items
      secondary: median_font_stats
      join_key: "constant"
      description: "Attach median font size to each text item for comparison"
    output: text_items_with_baseline

  - id: step_apply_heading_rule
    op: apply_rule
    params:
      input: text_items_with_baseline
      rule: "font_size_ratio_comparison"
      condition: "item.font_size > median_font_size * 1.2"
      classification:
        above_threshold: "heading"
        at_or_below_threshold: "body"
      description: "Classify text items as headings if font size is significantly above the median"
    output: classified_text_items

  - id: step_transform_structure
    op: transform_json
    params:
      input: classified_text_items
      mapping:
        headings: "items where classification == heading"
        body_text: "items where classification == body"
        structure: "hierarchical_document_tree"
      language: "fr"
      description: "Reshape classified items into structured document with headings and body sections"
    output: structured_document

  - id: step_format_final_output
    op: format_output
    params:
      input: structured_document
      format: "json"
      locale: "fr-FR"
      description: "Serialize the structured document for client-side rendering"
    output: final_output

  - id: step_log_extraction
    op: log_audit
    params:
      input: final_output
      action: "pdf_text_extraction_completed"
      details:
        processing: "client_side"
        language: "fr"
        detection_method: "font_size_ratio_comparison"
    output: audit_log_entry
dsl_type_errors: Step 'step_transform_structure': op 'transform_json' requires input of type 'records' but 'classified_text_items' has type 'boolean'. Make sure the step producing 'classified_text_items' uses an op that outputs a list of records (e.g. fetch_api, filter_records, validate_schema, read_database).
